title: Inner Line Permit and Protected Area Permit: Which States Need One and How to Apply Online

seoDescription: Inner Line Permit is needed in Arunachal, Nagaland, Mizoram and Manipur. State-wise portals, fees, validity and PAP/RAP rules for foreigners in 2026.
